dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Wh-What?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: What did you just say?!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Giorno!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: You're probably just not trying hard enough!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Bring him back!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Give it all you have, you b*stard!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: That's enough, Narancia!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Shut the hell up!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Narancia!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Abbacchio...

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Are we just going to leave him here, Bucciarati?!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Are we just going to leave Abbacchio all alone?!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: I don't want to leave him behind!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: This is an order, Narancia!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Abbacchio knew that this was a possibility when he came here!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: We're leaving.

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati, wait!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: That's...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati, wait. Just for a moment.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: This must mean something. It has to.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: He's holding something.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: What is it?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: It looks like a piece of rock from somewhere.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: It must mean something. Golden Wind!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Go back to where you came from!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Hey, look!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Apparently, Abbacchio had completed his replay!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: This is a death mask!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: A death mask from the replay!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Right before Abbacchio's Moody Jazz disappeared...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: It took the last of its Stand energy

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: and pressed its transformed face into the stone pillar!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Abbacchio left us this at the very end!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: This is the boss's true face!

dialogue.name: Cop
dialogue.speech: Abbacchio, you did a great job.

dialogue.name: Cop
dialogue.speech: And your will to get to your truth...

dialogue.name: Cop
dialogue.speech: The ones left behind will get it.

dialogue.name: Cop
dialogue.speech: Because that's what important.
